intro: Suggestions raised by this session. Nothing here has been implemented beyond this session's own files. Each lists the paths that were considered and a recommendation, so the choice can be made before any code changes. Items marked 'owner decision' touch a file another session owns; they are logged as change requests rather than executed.

suggestions.title: Move the engine's hard-coded window constants onto the manifest
suggestions.problem: scripts/strategy_lab.py hard-codes the live window (originate cutoff '2026-11-14', rest cutoff, SRC_SCHEDULE ?date=2026-11-14). The manifest now names the window (from/to), so the engine could read it and a rolling refresh would stop needing an engine edit every day.
suggestions.recommendation: owner decision: read window.from/window.to in _apply_manifest and derive the cutoffs; until then each refresh logs the hard-coded window as a known limitation (this session's leg C shows the manifest-driven slate already works because the cutoffs happen to match the window start).

suggestions.title: Add a fifth availability state for 'covered date, team absent'
suggestions.problem: NYK's zero rows publish as NO_OFFICIAL_REPORT_COVERS_THIS_DATE (F-94E6D41B-04) - the treatment is right, the label is wrong.
suggestions.recommendation: owner decision: add TEAM_ABSENT_ON_COVERED_DATE; keep the no-inference semantics identical.

suggestions.title: Extend the per-player minutes capture to all 465 rows
suggestions.problem: Only the top 31 players carry official minutes, so most listed absences contribute 0 to the vacated-minutes floor (F-94E6D41B-07, carried from F-1823b910-04). The official page paginates 9 chunks; a full capture is one extra session task.
suggestions.recommendation: capture rows 1-100+ with a stable naming (players_full_*.csv) and keep the top-31 file for the engine's index, or switch the engine to the full file after an owner review.

suggestions.title: Automate the quarter-score re-probe
suggestions.problem: Each refresh re-probes the same dead endpoints by hand (F-94E6D41B-02).
suggestions.recommendation: add the probe list to the capture script's checks so the negative result is recorded mechanically each refresh.
